warnings.finding: Unarmed launcher authors launch +420 although world Y is downward; sword launcher uses -640. Enemy.hit consumes launch directly. Also no unarmed launcher moveY hop is authored.
Non-drone launched enemy adds 1350*dt in launched state and 1900*dt in shared physics: effective 3250, not 1350.
Runtime info carries kbY, but Enemy.hit does not consume it as a general vertical impulse.
Attack moveX/moveY replace player velocity at a timestamp rather than applying a finite impulse; enemy reactions also replace velocity.
Declared chains are not the runtime input graph: pickLight maintains a global index; heavy uses first matching h entry; fromChain adds conditional relaxations.
Unarmed adapter preserves base.chain but drops launcher player hop and aerial juggle tuning; do not assume sword launcher-to-air routes survive adaptation.
Sword dash attacks use a fixed rear124/forward66 horizontal corridor at y-55 instead of visible blade sweep. Unarmed attacks do not use this corridor.
Hit processing checks current animT inside active interval; verify high-speed/large-dt crossing and multihit rearm under hitstop before changing attack speed.
